name: Trello
description: Trello organizes projects with boards, lists, and cards, making it easy to visualize work in progress.
best_for: Positioned for individuals and small teams first, scaling up to teams of around 100 and enterprise use cases.
features: Boards, lists, and cards for Kanban-style tracking
Power-Ups that connect other tools into a board
Templates from teams and industry playbooks
Due dates, checklists, and file attachments

alternatives.name: Asana
alternatives.description: A structured project-management platform with tasks, timelines, milestones, and reporting.

alternatives.name: ClickUp
alternatives.description: An all-in-one work-management platform with tasks, dashboards, documents, and automations.
alternatives.best_for: Teams needing more features and customization

alternatives.name: Notion
alternatives.description: A flexible workspace combining documents, databases, project boards, and team knowledge.
alternatives.best_for: Teams combining project tracking and documentation

alternatives.name: Zoho Projects
alternatives.description: An online project management platform for planning, tracking, and collaborating on work, with deep integration into the wider Zoho suite.
alternatives.best_for: Teams already using Zoho apps, and organizations wanting an affordable, feature-rich project tool

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Free for up to 10 collaborators per Workspace; unlimited cards and up to 10 boards per Workspace.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: $5/user/month billed annually ($6 billed monthly); adds unlimited boards, custom fields, advanced checklists, Planner, and more automation.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: $10/user/month billed annually ($12.50 billed monthly); adds Calendar, Timeline, Table, Dashboard, and Map views plus admin/security features.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: $17.50/user/month billed annually; adds organization-wide controls and Atlassian Guard Standard.
